== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The [[Blackflame]] [[Trials]] are a series of three ancient training course{{!}}training courses originally established by the first generation of [[sacred artists]] from the [[Blackflame family]]. These trials were designed to preserve the family's legacy by passing their specific [[Path]] down to future descendants. The trials are divided into three distinct segments that test the fundamental techniques of the [[Path]]: one for [[Enforcer]] abilities, one for [[Striker techniques]], and a final, most difficult trial for [[Rulers]]. While the trials were historically used by [[Blackflame elders]] to supervise and test their juniors, they can now be activated by anyone with the appropriate access keys. In recent times, following the fall of the [[Blackflame family]], they have been utilized to train students from various different [[Paths]]. The courses are capable of challenging any participant at the [[Lowgold]] level, regardless of their specific [[Path]]. One trial specifically focuses on testing spiritual endurance and teamwork rather than direct combat, requiring a single [[disciple]] to work with several protectors. Another trial is designed to pressure participants into a defensive position to test their ability to maintain [[Ruler techniques]].}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Located beneath the temple, the [[Blackflame]] [[Trials]] consist of three distinct challenges designed for [[Rulers]], Strikers, and [[Enforcer techniques]]. Upon entering the trials, the participant's Script{{!}}script is sealed behind them. These tests may involve assessments of foot speed, and the exit is protected by an [[aura]] barrier. Notably, the sound produced by the [[Goldsign]] during the [[Endless Sword]] [[technique]] resembles the gong used within the trials.}}
